verdict.rationale:
Marqeta documents rule-based automation for payment events: velocity controls and authorization controls automatically limit/approve spend based on merchant/time/amount conditions, and JIT funding lets a system auto-approve/deny funding requests in real time, with webhooks notifying on API events. This covers rule-triggered automation within the payments domain but is not a general-purpose event/rule engine (e.g., no arbitrary conditional workflows across resources) and there's no independent corroboration of these rules working reliably at scale.

missing for 10: general-purpose custom rule/workflow builder beyond spend controls, independent/hands-on evidence of rule automation working in production.
